base_address: Defined at SoC level; offsets given relative to module base.
notes: NVLink is an NVIDIA-proprietary GPU/die-to-die interconnect and does not publish a standardized protocol-level register map. Link configuration, status, and error counters are exposed through GPU/NVSwitch implementation-defined control/status registers and surfaced to software via the NVIDIA driver / NVML (NVIDIA Management Library) rather than a public spec register map.

link_control_status_conceptual.link_state: Per-link state (Down / Training / Active / Sleep) tracked by the link-management logic.
link_control_status_conceptual.link_width: Configured number of active differential lane pairs in the sub-link (full brick = 8 pairs/direction, reduced when lanes are deconfigured).
link_control_status_conceptual.link_speed_generation: NVLink generation / per-link bandwidth (Gen1 40 GB/s bidir; Gen2-4 50 GB/s bidir).
link_control_status_conceptual.error_counters: CRC error count, replay count, lane-deconfigure events per link.
link_control_status_conceptual.throughput_counters: TX/RX byte counters for bandwidth telemetry.

software_visible_telemetry_examples: NVML / nvidia-smi nvlink: per-link active/inactive, bandwidth, CRC + replay error counters.
NVSwitch fabric manager: routing tables, per-port link state, fabric health.
Driver-level peer-access enablement (GPU-to-GPU memory mapping over NVLink).
